title: Choose the visual world for Shigjetademy
question: The roll landed on a world built from your own logo: the arc loop and the arrow. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Arc & Arrow
options.lineage: The Shigjetademy mark itself: a circle of arc segments cut by one arrow shaft
options.thesis: The logo's circle is the school's operating loop; the arrow is every student moving through it.
materials: precise arc strokes sharing one center
large flat navy and green fields
options.viewport: Big confident headline left; right, a live dashboard sits inside a giant logo-geometry ring whose six arc segments are labelled Enrol, Schedule, Attend, Pay, Grade, Report; an arrow sweeps through them. 'Book a demo' is the primary button under the headline.
options.risk: If the arcs turn decorative instead of carrying the loop, it reads as a logo pasted large.

raised.raise: All motion runs off one shared clock (the arc sweep, scroll-driven), not scattered hover effects.
One strict rhythm: a single radius family and spacing grid as tokens; buttons settle physically on press.
Registration discipline: every arc on the page shares the logo's stroke weight and true center, so overlaps land exactly.
The workflow is a numbered sequence in a strict margin column; each step is a linkable, recoverable state.
The dashboard preview runs one school day with tabular timestamps and a single moving 'now' line.

options.label: The Timetable
options.lineage: The weekly school timetable pinned in every staff room
options.thesis: The whole page is laid on a Monday-to-Friday period grid; every feature is a coloured block in the week.
options.viewport: Headline sits in the Monday column; the rest of the viewport is this week's timetable filling in block by block, with 'Book a demo' as the free slot.
options.risk: Familiar: timetable-grid heroes are where many education SaaS pages land.

options.label: Departures Board
options.thesis: Today's classes shown as a departures board: rooms, times and teachers flipping into place.
options.viewport: A full-width board of today's sessions flips in; the headline is the board's title row; 'Book a demo' is the platform sign.
options.case: Strong recognition for anyone who runs a timetable, but a dark, loud board fights the brief's clean, minimal and premium feel.
options.risk: Can read as a gimmick rather than a serious operations platform.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller
options.thesis: Bitmap text on a drifting black void.
options.viewport: One ivory line of text on black.
options.case: Schools don't identify with it and it hides the product.
options.kept: One shared motion clock for the whole page.

options.label: Neubrutalist
options.thesis: Black outlines and hard offset shadows on clashing solids.
options.viewport: Bordered card grid with chunky buttons.
options.kept: Strict token-encoded rhythm and physical button press.

options.label: Screenprint Overlap
options.case: No link to running a school.
options.kept: Exact registration: shared centers and stroke weights.

options.label: Origami Sequence
options.thesis: A sheet folding step by step.
options.case: Metaphor is too distant from education operations.
options.kept: Numbered steps in a strict margin column.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.thesis: Sunlight moving through a building over a day.
options.viewport: A building section with a moving sunbeam.
options.case: Beautiful but indirect for school admins.
options.kept: A single day with tabular times and a moving 'now' line.
options.risk: Too abstract for a buying decision.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The clean SaaS homepage, like Deel's, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Centered headline, two buttons, a big dashboard screenshot below.
canonCard.risk: Hard to tell apart from other SaaS by design.
